endpoint.description:
Stable Audio transforms existing audio samples into new high-quality compositions up to six minutes
long at 44.1kHz stereo using text instructions.

### Try it out
Grab your [API key](https://platform.stability.ai/account/keys) and head over to
[![Open Google Colab](https://platform.stability.ai/svg/google-colab.svg)](https://colab.research.google.com/github/stability-ai/stability-sdk/blob/main/nbs/Stable_Audio_API.ipynb)
or try Stable Audio for free at [stableaudio.com](https://stableaudio.com).

This endpoint is asynchronous — it returns a generation `id` immediately (HTTP 202).
Poll `GET /v2beta/audio/results/{id}` to retrieve the result.

### Credits

**Stable Audio 3.0**

Flat rate of 8 credits per successful generation.

As always, you will not be charged for failed generations.

cURL
x-codeSamples.source:
generation_id=$(curl -sS -f "https://api.stability.ai/v2beta/audio/stable-audio/text-to-audio" \
  -H "authorization: Bearer sk-MYAPIKEY" \
  -H "accept: audio/*" \
  -F prompt="A cinematic orchestral piece with sweeping strings and dramatic brass." \
  -F output_format="mp3" \
  -F duration="30" \
  | jq -r '.id')

while true; do
  http_status=$(curl -sS -f \
    -o "./output.mp3" \
    -w '%{http_code}' \
    -H "authorization: Bearer sk-MYAPIKEY" \
    -H "accept: audio/*" \
    "https://api.stability.ai/v2beta/audio/results/${generation_id}")

  case $http_status in
    202) echo "Still processing. Retrying in 10 seconds..."; sleep 10 ;;
    200) echo "Download complete!"; break ;;
    *) echo "Error: $http_status"; exit 1 ;;
  esac
done

model.description:
The model to use for generation.

- `stable-audio-3` requires 8 credits per generation

duration.description: Controls the duration in seconds of the generated audio.

steps.description: Controls the number of sampling steps.

cfg_scale.description: How strictly the diffusion process adheres to the prompt text (higher values make your audio closer to your prompt). Defaults to 1 if not specified.

output_format.description: Dictates the `content-type` of the generated audio.

202.description: Generation started. Use the returned id to poll for the result.
